CheckTitle: GuardDuty EKS Audit Log Monitoring disabled
Description: GuardDuty detectors do not have EKS Audit Log Monitoring (EKS Protection) enabled, which capture sequential actions within the EKS cluster and perform continues threat detection.
Risk: Without EKS Protection security issues related to Kubernetes could remain undetected, affecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data, lead to privilege escalation, or unauthorized deployments.

Recommendation.Text: EKS Protection should be enabled on detectors across regions, using central management and limited access to scan results in accordance with the principle of least privilege.
